Hey all, I'm Henry Bosch, a Mathematics PhD student at Stanford university. You can find my website here: https://web.stanford.edu/~hbosch/

I'm interested in getting into formalization with lean4 (just started today). I'm particularly interested in pushing forward formalization in geometric analysis and PDE. I am beginning to work on formalizing Leon Simon's GMT book.

Excited to meet everyone here, and excited to learn more.
